what: Hovering shrinks the inner panel to .96x (.7s power4.out) and grows the arrow/icon to 1.3x (.5s). On release the panel wobbles back with elastic.out(1.5,.4) over 1.6s and the icon with a 1s elastic. Pressing the button dips it to .8x, then it bounces large over 1.7s. Adding a fill panel makes the dark color rise from below as the top rounded corners flatten

options.[data-fx-part=inner]: Shrinking panel (inner area wrapping background and text)
options.[data-fx-part=icon]: Growing arrows and icons — each icon can take its own multiplier via data-scale
options.press: If on, a press bounce. Default is on for a button

use: Your button here→

from.where: shared.js [data-fx~=elastic-shrink-hover] — header contact button·menu button·all card buttons (original data-js-hover=elastic + data-hover=bg)
